variants.headline: A company goes under
variants.body: A company has gone under in {colony}. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Business failure enters the colony's record
variants.body: The colony has seen a company fail. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: An enterprise reaches failure
variants.body: A business in the colony has gone under. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
